A1.statement: Deliver pure VSCore 0.3 source. Shade has exactly light, dark and neutral. Parcel has shade:Shade and n:Nat. Envelope has parcel:Parcel and active:Bool. The domain includes every Shade, every mathematical natural, every Envelope and every finite list, preserving order and duplicates. shiftEnvelopes(xs,increment) adds increment to each parcel.n and preserves shade and active. keepParcel(xs,needle) keeps exactly envelopes whose entire parcel equals needle. shadeTotal(xs,initial,shade) left-folds from initial, adding parcel.n exactly for matching shades. sameShade(x,y) returns the fixed canonical equality decision of the two shades. The source map calls a helper which calls another helper, with heterogeneous declared-order arguments; map/filter/fold lambdas capture increment, needle and shade respectively. The shadeTotal step also calls a helper. The accepted filter uses fixed enum/Nat field decisions, and source filtering uses intrinsic full Parcel equality; prove their universal correspondence. shiftEnvelopes also has independently required source properties and a Mixed value/source guarantee. A distinct inspectEnvelope source entry takes one Envelope and returns Nat, with source properties only and no value equation. Required source properties are typed total evaluation, deterministic results, preserved inputs, no external I/O or floating point, pure data and restricted runtime. An Envelope with light, zero and inactive witnesses the full typed domain. Deliver program.vscore.json under restricted VSCore source semantics; no host-language execution guarantee is requested.
